name: The United Laboratories International Holdings Limited
summary: The United Laboratories International Holdings Limited is a pharmaceutical investment holding company founded in 1990 and based in Yuen Long, Hong Kong. It covers drug research, manufacturing, distribution and sales through bulk medicine, intermediate products and finished goods divisions. Products include antibiotics, antivirals, cold and cough remedies, diabetes and cardiovascular drugs, vitamins, active ingredients and gelatin capsule shells, sold in China, Europe, India, the Middle East, South America and elsewhere.
